summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that runtime to execute a bundled 727KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with a rotated string/opcode array (functions WV8StW and n7gIxM) and randomized identifiers, and is not referenced by any of the package's TanStack Query/MobX library code. The package's declared purpose (a React Query + MobX integration) has no need for a second-language runtime or an opaque 700KB blob executed at install time; fetching Bun to run this payload evades Node-based static analysis. Every default `npm install` of this package fetches an alien runtime and executes attacker-controlled bundled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
